name: tabletopforge-native
description: Tauri-shelled native build of TableTop Forge — wraps the Express + PGlite backend in a webview-only desktop app.

scripts.build:frontend: npm run clean:frontend && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.tauri:dev: npm run fetch:node-binaries && npm run build:frontend && tauri dev
scripts.tauri:build: npm run fetch:node-binaries && npm run build:frontend && tauri build
scripts.tauri:build:signed: npm run fetch:node-binaries && npm run build:frontend && bash scripts/build-signed.sh
scripts.tauri:build:appstore: npm run fetch:node-binaries && npm run build:frontend && bash scripts/build-signed.sh appstore
